title: Go To Invoice opens the Finance tab and reverses nothing
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, invoiced (not paid), billed to customer B.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Expand the Customer card.
  3. Click the Bill To field.
  4. Click "Go To Invoice" in the toast.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens for customer A, with status Invoiced.

Step 2:

  • The Customer card's "Bill To" field reads customer B's name.

Step 3:

  • The error toast shows with "Go To Invoice".

Step 4:

  • Work order 1's Finance tab opens.
  • The invoice is still there and the work order's status is still Invoiced.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12307 (Story 5, Locked Bill To: invoiced and deposits)

  • S5-R3: “"Go To Invoice" opens the work order's or part sale's Finance tab; it never reverses anything.”
